Load penetration test on RS soil; apparatus: LPT fixture; loading: static penetration. Recorded: load vs penetration; DPT signature of the bed.

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
The measurements of this test have not been digitized yet; the setup and the source pages are indexed. The setup below rests on two agent readings of the report that were reconciled; no person has checked it yet. The report labels the soil state differently in two places (RS Intermediate; RS-Dense). The test setup is incomplete: relative density Dr, bin or mold, fill depth are not reported.
:::
